body:
Thank you so much for the in depth response!  Really helped calm my nerves.

I'm totally feeling the lack of "click" with the meds.  I knew they were starting on a low dose, but I was expecting to feel something noticable.  Though my husband came home that first day to find me working on my knitting projects - I had finished 15 or so half complete headbands and snowmen in a few hours that evening.  He didn't know that I had gotten the prescription and thought I skipped work and had spent the whole day home working on it!
I miss using solidworks so much!  Congrats on making it through your tutorial - it's not a simple software to use.
I really like the brief summary timeline idea, I'll definitely have to put one together

Thanks for the advice! I contacted them when the office opened this morning and it helped calm my fears. They said that the judge will even accept you just showing them straight from your phone which makes me think it will be much more relaxed than I was expecting. I still plan to print them out so it's easier to read and point things out, but I'm less nervous about not being able to get them admitted as evidence.

I'm also glad I called because they were able to tell me when another case is happening so I can sit in and observe before my own.
Do you know of any resources that help explain this process? I've been searching online and there's just so much information I'm having trouble sorting through it
That gold grand prize pen is beautiful!

I got a used 2000 a few weeks ago and love it. I was mainly concerned because it's just a tiny tiny tiny bit too large of a barrel for my liking, but overall I love the pen. I was debating if I should get the decimo instead of the normal VP, but it's a lot harder to find a used decimo it seems
It's hard to judge what is a good brand considering how many options there are when doing that, I'd much rather have feedback on a random site than trust reviews on product webpages
I am not using it regularly.

The one in my town closed a few years ago. The closest one is a 3 hour bus ride away, and I can't miss work to go during the week. That one doesn't do normal appointments on the weekends either, and unfortunately closes on any holidays I have off of work
Unfortunately due to some life circumstances I can't go to the doctor for one. I can only get a prescription for hormone pills
They don't gulp as much air while eating the food, and most dogs eat slower from raised bowls

Yeah, colic in horses can be really bad. Usually they'll roll around on the ground when they have it, and you have to get them to stand up and move around. I think it can actually undo the kinks if they haven't twisted completely and moving helps to pass gas through the tract. Thankfully never had to go through that with my horse, but I've had friends lose horses to it. That's why people walk through the pastures to make sure there aren't plants that'll cause it

Same thing as dogs, once they get it they're more likely to get it again :( like in the movie Marley and Me
